attack_techniques: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Authentication Package (T1547.002)
attackers_goals: Gain persistence using the legitimate Windows authentication package mechanism, which loads libraries into Windows services.
description: The endpoint registered a suspicious authentication package, which may be used to gain persistence on the host by loading libraries into the time management service.
investigative_actions: Verify if the registered library is malicious. Check if the installing software is a malicious binary. Check for any suspicious network activity from "lsass.exe".
name: Suspicious authentication package registered
